Applied as migration `m3b_referral_decline`.

Every prediction met.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
WHY THERE IS NO REASON FIELD

Decided 28 Aug 2026. The absence is the design, not an omission:

  A reason field would be a SECOND CHANNEL FOR CLINICAL CONTENT, sitting
  outside counselling_notes and its author-only policy — readable by both
  counsellors, and one schema change away from being readable by more. The
  whole M3 boundary is that what a counsellor learns about a client lives in
  their own notes and crosses only in a handover they wrote on purpose. A
  free-text "why I will not take this" is exactly that content entering by a
  side door.

  So the record is: Nicola declined, on this date. If Karabo needs to know why,
  she asks Nicola — a conversation between two clinicians, not a column.

THE MIGRATION ENFORCES THE ABSENCE. It refuses to apply if a reason-shaped
column exists on counselling_referrals, so the field cannot be added later
without somebody deliberately deleting the check that explains why it must
not. The test suite asserts the same thing independently (assertion 56).

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
WHAT DECLINING DOES, AND DOES NOT

  DOES  record that the receiving counsellor said no, with a date.
  DOES  stop that referral ever being accepted afterwards.
  DOES  tell Lone the outcome, so she does not route the next booking to a
        counsellor who never took the case.

  DOES NOT move any caseload. The client stays with the referring counsellor,
        who never stopped being responsible for them. The migration asserts
        this structurally: it refuses to apply if referral_decline contains any
        write to counsellor_clients.
  DOES NOT record, imply or transmit a reason.

WHO MAY DECLINE — the same gate as accepting

  Only the counsellor the referral was sent to. Not the referrer. Not Lone or
  Michelle: declining a case is as much a clinical decision as taking one, and
  the migration refuses to apply if referral_decline mentions is_admin or
  is_psychosocial_admin at all.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LOCAL SUITE — 59 assertions, 0 failed

The eight new ones:

  50 the REFERRING counsellor cannot decline her own referral
  51 a psychosocial admin cannot decline on anyone's behalf
  52 the receiving counsellor declines, and it is recorded with a date
  53 declining moves NO caseload — the client stays with the referrer
  54 declining twice is not an error
  55 a declined referral cannot then be accepted
  56 there is NO reason column, and must never be
  57 Lone sees one accepted and one declined, with dates and no content

Full regression, all exit 0: phase0 all, m1 22, m5 45, m5a 29, support 28,
m4 66, m4a 23, m3 59.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
THE ROLLBACK REFUSES TO DESTROY THE RECORD

rollback-m3b-referral-decline.sql will not run while any referral has been
declined: dropping declined_at deletes the only record that a counsellor said
no, and afterwards a declined referral is once again indistinguishable from one
nobody has read — the exact ambiguity M3b was built to end.

The harness hits that guard every run, because the suite declines one. It
clears them deliberately and reports "m3b guard ok (refused while 1 declined
referral(s) existed)", so the guard is EXERCISED rather than designed around.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
NOTHING IS WAITING ON IT

Zero referrals on live. Applied so the capability exists when Karabo and Nicola
need it.

SUPERSEDED — RISK ESCALATION HAPPENS OUTSIDE THE PLATFORM

  Decided 28 Aug 2026 and permanent, for confidentiality reasons. A counsellor
  escalates by REFERRING THE CLIENT TO EXTERNAL PARTIES according to the level
  of risk. That happens out of band, the way out-of-band contact always has.

  There is NO internal flag, NO notification, and NO admin action tied to a
  risk event. The content-free nameless action for Lone described in earlier
  specs is NOT BEING BUILT — not deferred, not owed, not pending.

  This matters for anything reading `actions`: there is no risk-flag row type
  coming, so nothing should be shaped to leave room for one.

  Recorded in claude/ops-data-model-and-impact.md §2.3a and §5 item 2, and in
  claude/ops-migration-governance.md's M3b section.
Lone when a counsellor raises a flag).
